title_vi: Một URL biến thành yêu cầu HTTP thế nào?

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body independently hashed as Git blob; computed OID matches provider tree OID. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Bài trước kể toàn bộ chuỗi từ lúc gõ địa chỉ tới khi trang hiện ra.

claims.evidence: MDN pages read from a local clone of mdn/content; the request line and Host header captured from a real curl request to a local socket server.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson at each width with optional sections open; diagram scale measured from the rendered image and every SVG text box checked against the viewBox. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: A URL is made of parts such as scheme, domain name, port, path, parameters and fragment; the fragment (after #) is never sent to the server with the request.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: An HTTP/1.x request has a request line (method, request target, version), headers such as Host, an empty line and an optional body; a response starts with a status line.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of mdn/content (developer.mozilla.org was unreachable).

claims.claim_vi: For curl --http1.1 'http://localhost:PORT/products/phone?color=black#specs' the server received 'GET /products/phone?color=black HTTP/1.1' and 'Host: localhost:PORT' with no trace of the fragment.
claims.verified_by: Captured the raw request received by a local socket server from curl 8.5.0.

design_notes_vi: Một URL ví dụ nhất quán, mỗi phần một thẻ nói nó đi đâu; thẻ fragment màu đỏ vì không rời trình duyệt. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source splits a URL into scheme, domain, path and a separate 'resource', and uses the path product/electric with a request for /phone; the lesson uses one consistent URL and folds the resource into the path.
Source does not mention that the fragment is never sent to the server.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
